before: FIELD 0.8.26 correctly reduced the root to one held object plus owner-based residue, but ordinary use still rendered a second three-cell HELD / NEXT / WITNESS→RETURN frame directly beneath the object. The frame repeated the object's identity and split continuation semantics across sibling geometry.
delta: Delete the sibling capTrial HELD/NEXT/WITNESS dashboard and its ?cap trial gate.
Nest NEXT plus WITNESS→RETURN directly inside the held object's existing aperture body.
Carry explicit manifest owner into the held object's own metadata instead of repeating owner + title in a second HELD cell.
When a native host exposes AVAILABLE actions, promote the first exact host action onto the existing primary apOpen edge and keep at most two additional host actions inline.
For generic routes, retain the primary OPEN/DO edge plus at most one explicit INTERPHASE→DAYLINE or COPY ACTION handoff.
Keep contextual SEEN on the object; keep TRACE, COMPARE, action-copy and AXIAL proof depth under REFINE / PROVE.
Retain witness and exact RETURN in ordinary view without giving them a second panel, store, priority or mutation authority.
laws: HELD / NEXT / WITNESS / RETURN describe one addressed object; they are not four surfaces.
NATIVE HOST ACTIONS MAY SHAPE THE PRIMARY EDGE BUT NEVER TRANSFER EFFECT AUTHORITY TO FIELD.

verification.source: PENDING exact-head CI: held-action selftest, public validator, route registration, gitleaks and critical browser smoke.
verification.human: No human gate required for correctness. Ordinary use may still show whether inline continuation density should be reduced further.
verification.limit: Machine proof establishes object/continuation ownership and authority boundaries, not subjective visual calm.

next: If green, inspect re-entry + glyph field only for repeated semantics. Prefer deleting or owner-folding repetition; do not add a new guide, dashboard or mode.
stop: Do not reintroduce a sibling continuation card/grid merely to make NEXT or RETURN more visually prominent.
